name: Spark Link
summary: Your phone and this PC, linked over the local network: links, files, phone notifications, battery, find my phone, and a shared clipboard if you switch it on. Pairs with Soot on Android.
summary_fr: Votre téléphone et ce PC, reliés par le réseau local : liens, fichiers, notifications du téléphone, batterie, retrouver le téléphone, et un presse-papiers partagé si vous l'activez. S'appaire avec Soot sur Android.
service: spark-link.service (systemd user unit, enabled by the window at the first pairing)

optional.gi (GObject, Gio): Plasma notifications, the clipboard through Klipper, and the mDNS announcement through Avahi
optional.avahi-daemon: phones find this PC by itself; without it they use the pairing link or the typed address
optional.soot: links from the phone open in Soot (else the default browser)
optional.kdialog: the KDE file picker for Send files

needs.system: Linux; Plasma 6 for notifications, the clipboard and Dolphin's Send to phone
